nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: I don't talk to people I don't know. Not round here.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: Clara Hale. She came here. She knew you.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: You're the husband. She showed me your photograph once.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: She was good, your Clara. She listened. Wrote things down. Said she was going to make sure people heard.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: Hargrove's buildings are killing people. The roof on number twelve caved in last winter. A child died. He paid the family to keep quiet.
nodes.journal_entry: Hargrove paid to cover up a child's death in his tenements. Clara had this. This is what she was going to expose.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: She said she'd sent everything to the newspaper. Said they'd have to print it.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: They didn't print it. The editor buried it.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: Then someone told Hargrove what she was doing. And he sorted it.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: Is that what happened to her? Tell me true.

choices.text: Yes. She was killed because of what she knew.
I don't know yet. That's what I'm finding out.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: I knew it. I told her it wasn't safe. She said someone had to.
nodes.journal_entry: Mary Doyle warned Clara it was dangerous. Clara went ahead anyway. Of course she did.

nodes.speaker: Mary Doyle
nodes.text: You find out. And then you make sure it matters. That's what she'd want.
